scope: Chapters 46–50: independently authored full Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish essays; Chinese and English editorial corrections synchronized. Chapter 45 is already complete and its body is not replaced.
style: Preserve every substantive argument and example, not the repetitive sentence scaffolding. Write an inviting native-language essay with scenes, developed paragraphs and a clear viewpoint. Put necessary qualifications beside the relevant claim once; do not turn every section into a defensive disclaimer. No invented anecdotes presented as facts. No translation service. Keep SAE vocabulary backstage; do not substitute a generic mindfulness essay for the author's specific reading. New examples may clarify, never supplant the original sequence.
source: Read the entire existing Chinese essay-body lang-zh in essays/daodejing/chNN.html before drafting. The main agent is preparing corrected chNN.zh.md; use that when available and compare before final delivery. Classical source panels remain untouched. Adopted readings are editorial readings, not a verified diplomatic transcription or universal philological consensus.
format: data/daodejing-full/chNN.LANG.md: one # title, then ## sections (46:7,47:5,48:7,49:6,50:7). Preserve original paper footer links and useful chapter cross-links (relative chNN.html). Full essays, not summaries; roughly 1500–2100 English/European-language words where needed, Japanese/Korean with corresponding argument depth. Do not pad to a count. HTML/build/tests/receipts belong to main agent. Use apply_patch. Do not commit.

46.coverage: Seven stages: noticing the three moments; horses returning to agriculture vs horses born amid war; 可欲 (attraction); 不知足 (moving goalposts); 欲得/憯 (possession at any price, cost and hurt); 知足之足恒足; reader's three checks. Retain career, earnings, relationships, social-media comparison, escalating rulers and the connection to chapters 3/9/30/33/37/44/45.
46.corrections: Three moments are this commentary's useful interpretive lens, not a proven chronological psychology encoded by Laozi. Wanting and noticing an opportunity are not moral crimes. Do not promise effortless early release or certain disaster/immunity. Craving even at 'any price' is NOT irreversible or untreatable: pause commitments, seek trusted/professional help as relevant, stop additional harm even if lost opportunities cannot be recovered. 憯 conveys painful/severe force, does not establish an absolute no-return point. 郊 = outskirts, not automatically state frontier; wartime breeding scene, no invented universal horse-conscription logistics. Political restraint does not mean abandoning protection/public services. Enough must leave room for unmet needs, basic material security and fair treatment; don't tell poor/abused readers to accept deprivation. Public rivalry/status display can fuel desire; no policy of concealing all desirable objects.

47.coverage: Five sections: outward rush; door/window and local depth/shared patterns; more collection less understanding; all three 不行而知/不见而明/弗为而成 with connections to 16/22/33/37/48; three practical reader invitations. Retain courses/books/certificates/travel/networking/newsfeed and experienced worker versus endless conferences examples.
47.corrections: Not anti-learning, anti-travel or empirical evidence. Reflection connects observations; introspection cannot reveal all facts. 'Not going out' is an image in this reading, not a lexical definition of external processing. Adopted 明 vs received 名 can be mentioned once without claiming rival reading simply wrong. Shared patterns do not erase others' distinct circumstances. Reduction of coercive busyness can help work, not magical guaranteed completion. Study is genuinely hard and valuable, not always superficial badge collection. Make specific depth plus return to evidence central.

48.coverage: Seven sections: additive era; study/hearing Dao contrast; active difficult subtraction; repeated subtraction and wuwei; action without image maintenance; governance 取天下 and relationships/products/reputation; reader practice. Preserve learning/credentials/identities, surgeon metaphor moderated, expert facade and attention, product retention and relationship grasping.
48.corrections: 为学 literally study and can cultivate real ability; do not redefine as only vanity. Adopted 闻道 reading foregrounds receptivity but received 为道 not necessarily acquisitive/power-seeking. Subtract needless defensive habits, not knowledge, personhood, values, duties or protective boundaries. Surgery metaphor becomes careful discriminating repair, not self-hatred/violent self-erasure. No final completely unconditioned authentic self/guaranteed success. 无不为 points to responsive capacity, not omnipotence. Non-grasping no strategy to secretly own people or get power; institutions/support/necessary action remain. Keep author's clear positive thesis.

49.coverage: Six sections: controlling vs abandoning; 恒无心/以百姓心为心; good to not-good and trust to untrustworthy; waiting/gardener/孩之 with complete closing wording 歙歙焉、为天下浑心、百姓皆属耳目焉; support before waiting; leader/parent/teacher checklist and closing image. Do not omit trust clause or awkward source lines.
49.corrections: No giving up personal conscience/standards; listening does not make one all-knowing representative. 善/信 baseline regard vs evidence-based trust: maintain safeguards, accountability, protect potential victims, no unconditional access for abusers. 不善 is not simply slow learning. 孩之 is a care image in this essay, not warrant infantilizing citizens/adults. 耳目 does not prove people stupid/unenlightened. 歙歙/浑心 difficult readings acknowledge briefly with scholarly modesty; don't define as erasing citizens' minds. Education can nurture; no binary education=coercion. Waiting includes explanation/feedback/safety intervention; all needs cannot be perfectly met before space is given, continuous support. People remain free to decline mentor's hoped-for destination.

50.coverage: Seven sections: trying too hard to preserve life; numbers and mortality; 生生 and self-defeating efforts; 善执生 versus heroism; tiger/rhino/weapons/无死地 and wall saying, investment/leverage, conflict and business examples; contrast grasping vs responsive care; two reader checks. Preserve health-related example modestly, overcontrol, overwork, hoarding/safety-anxiety examples.
50.corrections: 十有三 has differing old interpretations: Wang Bi three in ten, Heshang Gong thirteen bodily gates/joints. No demographic statistics, innate 'good fate/bad fate' classes or guaranteed missing 10% elite. Even 3/10 reading doesn't prove old essay's four categories. 生生 applies concern with maintaining/enriching life; interpret overgrasping without condemning desire to live or medical care. No illness/death blamed on poor wisdom/anxiety, no guarantees safe routes/wise people immune to tiger/war. Text's hyperbolic imagery supports prudent avoidance as this commentary's application, not only literal meaning. Luck/social conditions matter, vulnerable people lack exit options; protection is also collective responsibility. Necessary courage to rescue/protect not foolishness. Mencius exact line '是故知命者，不立乎巖牆之下' (尽心上2); common 君子不立于危墙之下 is later familiar paraphrase, don't call it exact quotation. No treatment advice or specific investment recommendations.

verified_sources.use: Author's theoretical commentary, not independent confirmation; original classical panels already derive from it. Do not edit source-paper site.
